metadata.title: Juvenile-to-adult zebrafish stripe-addition normal table and iridophore S/L (dense/loose) transition rules used by the Pass 3 hybrid continuum-agent model
metadata.confidence_note: Standard lengths (SL) are the stage anchors of the Parichy et al. (2009) normal table. The stripe counts per stage are APPROXIMATE qualitative readings of the published descriptions and figures of Parichy et al. (2009), Frohnhoefer et al. (2013) and Singh et al. (2014); they were not digitized from a quantitative table and should be treated as +/- 1 stripe. The hybrid model is compared against them as ordinal checkpoints, not as exact targets.

sources.citation: Volkening A, Sandstede B (2015). Modelling stripe formation in zebrafish: an agent-based approach. Journal of the Royal Society Interface 12(112):20150812.
sources.used_for: agent-based melanophore/xanthophore rules on a growing domain; sequential stripe addition during growth

sources.citation: Volkening A, Sandstede B (2018). Iridophores as a source of robustness in zebrafish stripes and variability in Danio patterns. Nature Communications 9:3231.
sources.used_for: dense (S) <-> loose (L) iridophore shape transitions driven by the local melanophore/xanthophore environment; iridophores as a robustness mechanism

sources.citation: Singh AP, Schach U, Nuesslein-Volhard C (2014). Proliferation, dispersal and patterned aggregation of iridophores in the skin prefigure striped colouration of zebrafish. Nature Cell Biology 16(6):607-614.
sources.used_for: iridophores emerge along the horizontal myoseptum (X0), proliferate as a dense sheet, disperse as loose cells across the forming stripes and re-aggregate into dense sheets at the next interstripes

sources.citation: Frohnhoefer HG, Krauss J, Maischein HM, Nuesslein-Volhard C (2013). Iridophores and their interactions with other chromatophores are required for stripe formation in zebrafish. Development 140(14):2997-3007.
sources.used_for: dense iridophores in interstripes / loose iridophores in stripes; iridophore-less shady (ltk) mutants fail to form organized stripes (iridophore-less control)

sources.citation: Patterson LB, Parichy DM (2013). Interactions with iridophores and the tissue environment required for patterning melanophores and xanthophores during zebrafish adult pigment stripe formation. PLoS Genetics 9(5):e1003561.
sources.used_for: iridophores promote xanthophore development locally and organize melanophores (sign of the agent -> continuum feedback terms)

sources.citation: Parichy DM, Elizondo MR, Mills MG, Gordon TN, Engeszer RE (2009). Normal table of postembryonic zebrafish development: staging by externally visible anatomy of the living fish. Developmental Dynamics 238(12):2975-3015.
sources.used_for: standard-length anchors of the post-embryonic stages PB, PR, SP, J, J+, J++

sources.citation: Crampin EJ, Gaffney EA, Maini PK (1999). Reaction and diffusion on growing domains: scenarios for robust pattern formation. Bulletin of Mathematical Biology 61(6):1093-1120.
sources.used_for: Lagrangian form of reaction-diffusion on a uniformly growing domain: dilution term -(d/dt ln A) u and diffusion scale D / g(t)^2

growth_mapping.description: Isometric mapping used by the script: flank height L_y(t) = g(t) * 9.2 (dimensionless adult height); standard length SL(mm) = 7.2 * g / 0.40, so g0 = 0.40 <-> stage PB (7.2 mm) and g = 1 <-> SL 18 mm.

stripe_addition_normal_table.description: Approximate number of complete dark melanophore stripes on the trunk flank at each Parichy et al. (2009) stage anchor (see confidence_note). Interstripe/stripe nomenclature: X0 (horizontal myoseptum interstripe), 1D/1V first dorsal/ventral stripes, X1D/X1V second interstripes, 2D/2V second stripes, 3V partial ventral stripe in large adults.

stages.event: iridophores appear along the horizontal myoseptum (X0); melanophores begin to organize into 1D and 1V
1D and 1V stripes flank X0; X0 dense iridophore sheet proliferating
X1V interstripe prefigured ventrally by re-aggregating dense iridophores
adult pattern; 3V may be added ventrally in large adults

stripe_addition_normal_table.asymmetry_note: In vivo, new interstripes/stripes are added ventrally before dorsally (X1V/2V before X1D/2D). The reduced hybrid model is dorsoventrally symmetric and inserts X1D and X1V simultaneously; this is a declared residual.

iridophore_sl_rules_reduced.description: Reduced form of the Volkening & Sandstede (2018) iridophore rules implemented in simulate_hybrid_iridophore_growth().
iridophore_sl_rules_reduced.S_to_L: P = dt * r_SL * sigmoid((u - v - theta) / 0.08)  [melanophore-dominated neighbourhood]
iridophore_sl_rules_reduced.L_to_S: P = dt * r_LS * sigmoid((v - u - theta) / 0.08)  [xanthophore-dominated neighbourhood]

expected_occupancy.source: Frohnhoefer et al. (2013) Fig. 1-2 and Singh et al. (2014) Fig. 1: dense iridophores are confined to interstripes, loose iridophores cover stripes (qualitative)

growing_domain_mode_insertion.description: Neumann cosine modes cos(n*pi*y/L) inside the Nakamasu (2009) Turing band k in [2.1134, 5.3669]: k_min*L <= n*pi <= k_max*L. Integer kernel checked by Lean 4 Theorem 4 (k x 1e4, pi x 1e5, L x 10).
